runtime.origin: Microsoft .NET and WindowsDesktop x64 runtime packs

magick-native.required: Match the statically linked native binary to Magick.Native build flags and link inputs. Provide corresponding source and a tested replacement/relink procedure for the LGPL delegates, including HEIF, de265, GLib, Pango and RSVG.

qpdf-runtime.required: Confirm the distributor holds applicable Visual Studio redistribution rights for the bundled Microsoft CRT DLLs and verify each basename against the matching REDIST list.

libreoffice.required: Supply recipients with the version-specific source manifest and confirm availability of external component sources listed by this build and their redistribution terms in LICENSE.html.
